description: Compare one symbol across two exact package versions and show commit-pinned evidence. For release notes and build/runtime requirements, use ChangeSignal with the same package and versions. See https://versionproof-beta.handy-drake-3041.chatgpt.site/integrations/github#agent-task for the paired Dependabot procedure.

from.description: The exact currently pinned release, such as 2.32.5. Do not use a range or latest.

package.description: Use the PyPI name shown in the coverage tool, such as requests. Do not enter a repository URL.

symbol.description: Use the exact symbol identifier in list_coverage, such as request or AsyncClient.__init__. Do not enter a file path.

to.description: The exact proposed release, such as 2.33.0. Do not use a range or latest.

name: compare_exact_versions
